text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Don't be so down. Winning and losing are 
just the luck of the draw, as they say."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You gave it your all for my sake, Boss. 
And that's more than enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis did her best for me. That alone 
is more than enough."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wipe that gloomy look off your face! 
Let's go grab something tasty to eat!
It ended in a disappointing result...
